run.sql: CREATE TABLE dbo.merge_target(id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,n INT NOT NULL)
INSERT dbo.merge_target(id,n) VALUES (1,10),(2,20),(3,30)
SELECT id,n FROM dbo.merge_target ORDER BY id

MERGE dbo.merge_target AS t USING (VALUES (1,11)) AS s(id,n) ON t.id=s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET n=s.n OUTPUT $action AS action, inserted.id AS inserted_id, deleted.n AS prior_n, inserted.n AS current_n;
SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS affected

MERGE dbo.merge_target AS t USING (VALUES (4,40)) AS s(id,n) ON t.id=s.id WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN INSERT (id,n) VALUES (s.id,s.n) OUTPUT $action AS action, inserted.id AS inserted_id, inserted.n AS current_n;
SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS affected

MERGE dbo.merge_target AS t USING (VALUES (1),(2),(4)) AS s(id) ON t.id=s.id WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE AND t.id=3 THEN DELETE OUTPUT $action AS action, deleted.id AS deleted_id, deleted.n AS prior_n;
SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS affected
SELECT id,n FROM dbo.merge_target ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE dbo.merge_mix(id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,n INT NOT NULL)
INSERT dbo.merge_mix(id,n) VALUES (1,10),(2,20),(3,30)
CREATE TABLE dbo.merge_output([action] NVARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,inserted_id INT NULL,deleted_id INT NULL)

MERGE dbo.merge_mix AS t
    USING (VALUES (1,11),(2,22),(4,44)) AS s(id,n) ON t.id=s.id
    WHEN MATCHED AND s.id=1 THEN UPDATE SET n=s.n
    WHEN MATCHED AND s.id=2 THEN DELETE
    WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN INSERT (id,n) VALUES (s.id,s.n)
    WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE AND t.id=3 THEN DELETE
    OUTPUT $action, inserted.id, deleted.id INTO dbo.merge_output([action],inserted_id,deleted_id);
SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS affected
SELECT [action],inserted_id,deleted_id FROM dbo.merge_output ORDER BY [action],COALESCE(inserted_id,deleted_id)
SELECT id,n FROM dbo.merge_mix ORDER BY id
WITH s AS (SELECT 5 AS id,50 AS n) MERGE dbo.merge_target AS t USING s ON t.id=s.id WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN INSERT (id,n) VALUES (s.id,s.n);
SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS affected
SELECT id,n FROM dbo.merge_target ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE dbo.merge_duplicate(id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,n INT NOT NULL)
INSERT dbo.merge_duplicate(id,n) VALUES (1,10)
MERGE dbo.merge_duplicate AS t USING (VALUES (1,11),(1,12)) AS s(id,n) ON t.id=s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET n=s.n;
SELECT id,n FROM dbo.merge_duplicate ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE dbo.merge_constraint(id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,n INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT CK_merge_positive CHECK (n>0))
INSERT dbo.merge_constraint(id,n) VALUES (1,10)
MERGE dbo.merge_constraint AS t USING (VALUES (1,11),(2,-1)) AS s(id,n) ON t.id=s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET n=s.n WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN INSERT (id,n) VALUES (s.id,s.n);
SELECT id,n FROM dbo.merge_constraint ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE dbo.merge_rollback(id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,n INT NOT NULL)
INSERT dbo.merge_rollback(id,n) VALUES (1,10)
BEGIN TRANSACTION
MERGE dbo.merge_rollback AS t USING (VALUES (1,11),(2,20)) AS s(id,n) ON t.id=s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET n=s.n WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN INSERT (id,n) VALUES (s.id,s.n);
SELECT id,n FROM dbo.merge_rollback ORDER BY id
ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
SELECT id,n FROM dbo.merge_rollback ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE dbo.merge_top(id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,n INT NOT NULL)
MERGE TOP (0) dbo.merge_top AS t USING (VALUES (1,10)) AS s(id,n) ON t.id=s.id WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN INSERT (id,n) VALUES (s.id,s.n);
SELECT id,n FROM dbo.merge_top ORDER BY id
MERGE TOP (1) dbo.merge_top AS t USING (VALUES (1,10)) AS s(id,n) ON t.id=s.id WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN INSERT (id,n) VALUES (s.id,s.n);
SELECT id,n FROM dbo.merge_top ORDER BY id
MERGE TOP (-1) dbo.merge_top AS t USING (VALUES (2,20)) AS s(id,n) ON t.id=s.id WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN INSERT (id,n) VALUES (s.id,s.n);
SELECT id,n FROM dbo.merge_top ORDER BY id
MERGE dbo.merge_top AS t USING (VALUES (1,11)) AS s(id,n) ON t.id=s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET n=s.n WHEN MATCHED AND s.n>0 THEN DELETE;
MERGE dbo.merge_top AS t USING (VALUES (1,11)) AS s(id,n) ON t.id=s.id WHEN MATCHED AND s.n>0 THEN UPDATE SET n=s.n WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET n=s.n;
